Jo paas hai wo dekho, hamesha zyada milega.
Success matlab jo chahiye wo milna.
Hell se guzar rahe ho, chalte raho.
Mindset, talent se zyada matter karta hai.
"Kuch nahi chalega—jab tak tum nahi karo."
"Win chahiye? Winner jaisa socho."
Mehnat karo, luck milega.
"Secret: consistency."
Mind jab stretch hota hai, purani limits me wapas nahi aata.
Jo bhi karo, shiddat se karo.
Tumhara mind ek garden hai; thoughts seeds hain.
Aaj avoid karke kal ki responsibility se bhaag nahi sakte.
"Tum woh ban jaate ho jo practice karte."
